a note on the study

new sound.
same conversation.

These studies focus on the small interface sounds. Effects follow visible clicks, message changes and typed input; titles and AI responses do not become keyboard noise. They are not identical reproductions of the reference recordings.

UI effects come from Kenney’s CC0 Interface Sounds and unicae games’ CC0 keyboard recordings. Custom synthesis fills gaps such as message movement. Music is an optional background layer.

All three sound modes use the same independent picture recreation. Rene keeps the graphic sequences and skips the live-action interval in every mode.
